_about: What you see in Look around (Esc menu): ← → move between the window, each cat in the room and your table.
names: the panel's title for the window and your table (cats show their own name).
spots: each cat spot in words, for {where} in the cats' look lines (content/moments).
window, table: lines describing them; the game picks one that fits. Conditions (all optional):
weather (clear, cloudy, drizzle, rain, heavy_rain, fog, snow), when (late night, dawn, morning, afternoon, evening, night),
cup (table only: none, warm, cooling, low, empty; {drink} is your drink). Lines with conditions are picked more often;
each needs at least one line with none. Keep each line to about two lines of the box (90 letters).

window.text: Rain runs down the glass. The rooftops are dark and shiny.
The rain is loud on the glass. Nobody is out on the balconies.
A soft drizzle. The zinc roofs have gone grey.
Fog has swallowed the far rooftops. Only the nearest chimneys show.
Snow is settling on the rooftops and on the balcony rail.
Low clouds over Paris. The light is soft and even.
The sun is on the zinc roofs. Somewhere, a window is open.
The sky over the rooftops is getting lighter.
The Eiffel Tower is lit, and windows glow across the street.
Lit windows across the street go dark, one by one.
The city is asleep. A single window is still lit.
The rooftops of Paris, chimney pots and all.

table.text: Your book is open on the marble. No cup yet.
Your {drink} is still warm. Steam curls up from it.
There's a little {drink} left at the bottom.
Your cup is empty. It left a faint ring on the marble.
The candle flickers on the marble.
The marble is cool under your hands. Your book is open.
